entities.summary: Kyrylo Yevhenovych Shevchenko is a Ukrainian banker and a former Head of the National Bank of Ukraine from July 2020 until October 2022, when he resigned and left Ukraine due to alleged political persecution. Shevchenko is also a former chairman of the board of state-owned Ukrgasbank from 2014 to 2020.
